you_should_know.title: At D1 town hall, Jones warns of deeper cuts ahead as she defends her budget proposals
you_should_know.summary: Continuation of the SA mayor budget-deficit incident — Jones defending budget cuts and Ready to Work redirection at a town hall. A political-institutional story landing on this metro; context worth walking in aware of, unsafe as an opener. Keep as you should know.
you_should_know.description: Mayor Gina Ortiz Jones told residents San Antonio faces deeper budget cuts than expected as she defended her proposal to redirect Ready to Work funds.At D1 town hall, Jones warns of deeper cuts ahead as she defends her budget proposals was first posted on July 30, 2026 at 1:19
